diagnosis.statement: The rejected inference is not a false restricted theorem. It is a transfer error: minimizing over the larger full witness class gives rho_full <= rho_restricted, the opposite direction needed to pass a lower bound downward to rho_full.

failure.falsifier: W_res subseteq W_full implies rho_full <= rho_res

obstruction.statement: To reuse a restricted-model lower bound for full Definition-21 rho, an independent reverse comparison rho_restricted <= g(rho_full) with useful explicit g, or a direct full-rho theorem, is required.

trigger_signature: lower bound proved in restricted model/witness class
target consumer has larger/easier legal witness class
lesson.action: derive exact feasible-set/model inclusion and induced inequality direction before transfer; block lower-bound reuse unless a reverse bridge is independently established
lesson.falsifier: produce an assumption-preserving reverse comparison or a direct full-model theorem

motif.template: restricted theorem -> type feasible-set inclusion -> derive monotonicity polarity -> require reverse bridge before lower-bound transfer
